seq=[None]*n
useddiff=[False]*n

def dfs(pos):

        print(seq)
        return True
    if pos==0:
        candidates=vals
    else:
        # try larger unused diffs first? candidate values with unused diff
        last=seq[pos-1]
        candidates=[]
        for d in range(n-1,0,-1):
            if not useddiff[d]:
                for v in (last+d,last-d):

    for v in candidates:

            if d==0 or useddiff[d]: continue
        seq[pos]=v; used[v]=True
        if pos>0: useddiff[d]=True
        if dfs(pos+1): return True

        used[v]=False; seq[pos]=None
